failure_reason: Genuine curated Bestsellers PLPs were found and confirmed for the Home & Kitchen department (whole-department listing + 4 real sub-department children), but noon.com's own UI never displays an exact product count for any of them -- only a rounded/bucketed figure ("100+", "200+", "700+"). Per the qty rule this is recorded as qty:null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than estimated, so a large fraction of rows are null even though the category structure itself is reliably confirmed.
notes:
SCOPE: restricted to the Home & Kitchen department per task instruction (broader than the prior Home-Decor-only pass for this company). ACCESS: direct HTTP fetch via curl_cffi (Chrome TLS impersonation) worked reliably (HTTP 200 on every request); plain curl/PowerShell/urllib and Playwright's bundled Chromium all failed to complete the TCP/TLS handshake to noon.com from this environment (curl: connect timeout; Playwright: net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR / timeout) -- consistent with this project's known intermittent-egress issue, worked around via curl_cffi. One live check via Claude-in-Chrome (real browser) on /home_decor-bestseller-AE/ confirmed the rendered page shows the identical bucketed '100+ Results for "Best Sellers"' text as the SSR HTML, proving the exact count genuinely is not exposed anywhere in the UI (not just an SSR truncation) -- no numFound/totalCount/hits field exists in the page's embedded JSON either. robots.txt explicitly allows ClaudeBot (Allow: /), separate/looser than the generic '*' group.

DISCOVERY: checked main nav mega-menu (Home & Kitchen > Home decor/Furniture/Kitchen & dining/Tools & home improvement/Bath & bedding), and the dedicated landing pages for each of those 5 sub-departments (/home-kitchen/, /home-decor/, /furniture/, /kitchen-dining/, /tools-and-home-improvement-store/, /bath-and-bedding/). Found a genuine tabbed 'Home kitchen bestseller' module on /home-kitchen/ with 4 real per-department tabs (Home Decor, Furniture, Kitchen, Tools) each linking to its own distinctly-titled, distinctly-counted '<X>-bestseller-AE' / '<x>-bestsellers-ae' page (all literally titled 'Best Sellers' as their own H1, small bucketed counts 100-200 consistent with a curated tag list, not a full category). Recorded these as a grouping row (whole-department) + 4 leaf children, matching the site's own tab structure.

EXCLUDED as non-genuine: 'Bestsellers in bedding' and 'Bestsellers in bath' carousels shown on /bath-and-bedding/ -- opened both; their VIEW ALL links resolve to the entire Bedding/Bath category pages (H1 'Bedding in UAE' / 'Bath in UAE', ~100K+ results each), i.e. the whole category merely sorted by popularity, not a genuine curated Bestsellers PLP -- fails the 'real bestseller merchandising concept, not an arbitrary filter page' test in Sec 3. Also excluded the marketplace-wide /uae-en/bestsellers/ banner seen on the homepage since it is not Home & Kitchen-scoped (out of this task's department scope), and per-department Bestsellers pages for unrelated departments (Baby, Toys, Fragrance) surfaced in the same mega-menu.

No local-language (Arabic) equivalent pages were separately checked beyond what the English-locale (uae-en) pages themselves exposed; site defaults fully to English content under /uae-en/.
